title: Motivic Vanishing Cycles at Infinity and Toric Landau-Ginzburg Mirror Symmetry
summary: We compare motivic nearby cycles at infinity with classes computed directly on rational compactifications. Let $f$ be a regular function on a smooth variety over a field of characteristic zero, and let $X$ be a smooth proper compactification. Suppose that a reduced divisor containing the boundary and the support of $\operatorname{div}_X(f)$ has simple normal crossings near the polar locus. We prove that the open-pair class defined by $1/f$ agrees with Raibaut's compactification-independent motivic nearby cycle at infinity.
